agent_runs_finish.name: agent_runs_finish
agent_runs_finish.using: private.is_member("agent_runs"."workspace_id") and "agent_runs"."status" = 'running' and ("agent_runs"."created_by" = (select auth.uid()) or "agent_runs"."created_at" < now() - interval '10 minutes')

workspace_members_insert.name: workspace_members_insert
workspace_members_insert.withCheck: ("workspace_members"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) and "workspace_members"."role" = 'owner' and private.workspace_owner("workspace_members"."workspace_id") = (select auth.uid())) or (private.has_role("workspace_members"."workspace_id", array['owner']) or (private.has_role("workspace_members"."workspace_id", array['admin']) and "workspace_members"."role" <> 'owner'))

workspace_members_delete.name: workspace_members_delete
workspace_members_delete.using: "workspace_members"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) or (private.has_role("workspace_members"."workspace_id", array['owner']) or (private.has_role("workspace_members"."workspace_id", array['admin']) and "workspace_members"."role" <> 'owner'))
